id: <fill in: a lower-case id for this company, e.g. my-desk>
name: <fill in: the company's name>

inference.baseUrl: <fill in: the endpoint including /v1, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1 or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1>
inference.apiKeyEnv: <fill in: the NAME of the environment variable that holds the key, e.g. OPENROUTER_API_KEY; delete this line for a local endpoint>
inference.model: <fill in: the model every handler uses unless you list one below>

sales.handoff.card.model: <fill in: a different model for the handoff card, or delete the whole handlers block>

limits.maxModelCallsPer24h: <fill in: a number, the most model calls this company may make in 24 hours>

authorisedSenders: <fill in: an opaque reference for who may give commands, e.g. owner-ref>

enquiryFields.name: <fill in: lower_case_name, e.g. tour_or_service>
enquiryFields.description: <fill in: what the customer message tells you here>

persona.name: <fill in: a first name for the assistant, or delete this line>

humanClaimPhrases: <fill in: a phrase in your customers' language that would mean the bot claims to be a person, or delete this line>

office.timezone: <fill in: an IANA name, e.g. Atlantic/Madeira>

wording.onDuty: <fill in: what the bot is told when the office is staffed, or delete the whole wording block to keep the English default>
wording.outOfOffice: <fill in: what the bot is told when nobody is in>
wording.outOfOfficeWithNote: <fill in: the same with {note} where the staff note or the time the office is back goes>
